topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: When I heard the news, the room seemed to tilt. My best friend, the one who knew the darkest secrets of my soul, the silent witness to my triumphs and defeats, was leaving. Moving across the country. A surge of energy pushed me to the window, where I traced the path of a lone leaf swirling in the wind, much like the turmoil inside me. I can't help but smile at the absurdity, the cruel twist of fate that binds us to moments of departure. Yet, in the chaos, there's a kind of clarity, a sharpness to my thoughts that feels almost invigorating. We'll find a way to keep our friendship alive, to bridge the miles with more than just words, but with the essence of who we are.
